label: ID
description: Unique short name (lowercase, no spaces); used in share links

label: Name
description: Model name as shown in the app

label: Market
description: Country the price applies to (e.g. TH)

label: Currency
description: Currency of price, energy price and maintenance (THB, EUR, …)

label: Price
description: Purchase price in the car's currency

label: Powertrain
description: BEV = battery electric. ICE cars are modelled like an EV (approximation, as in the spreadsheet)

label: Body type
description: Selects default drag coefficient and frontal area when those are missing (see body_types.csv)

label: Car class
description: Onboard base loads and cabin heating/AC curve (Facts tab: regular vs. large or premium)

label: Long-term capacity
description: Share of nominal capacity left after years of use. Blank = assumption (80 %)

label: Battery type
description: Cell chemistry; selects the temperature-dependent discharge curves

label: Battery cycles
description: Rated full charge cycles

label: Consumption of motors
description: From the same source and standard as the rated range. Blank = battery ÷ rated range

label: Rated range CLTC
description: Chinese test cycle

label: Rated range NEDC
description: New European Driving Cycle

label: Rated range WLTP
description: Worldwide harmonised procedure

label: Rated range EPA
description: US EPA label

label: Consumption standard
description: Only needed when ranges for several standards are given; otherwise taken from the filled range column

label: Onboard systems (Simple model)
description: Used only by the Simple (spreadsheet) model. Your note: sources mention between 3 and 10 kWh

label: Charging test from
description: Published fast-charging figure, e.g. 10 → 80 % in 30 min

label: Fast charging starts at
description: Below this, charging runs at the reduced (taper) speed. Blank = charging test 'from'

label: Fast charging ends at
description: Above this, charging runs at the reduced (taper) speed. Blank = charging test 'to'

label: Drag coefficient (Cd)
description: Blank = body-type default

label: Frontal area
description: Blank = 0.85 × width × height, or body-type default

label: Width
description: Without mirrors

label: Curb weight
description: Blank = estimated from battery size

label: Tyre rolling resistance
description: EU tyre label value (e.g. 7.0). Blank = assumption

label: Power
description: HP is calculated (× 1.341)

label: ACC
description: Adaptive cruise control (yes / no)

label: Energy price override
description: Per kWh (or per litre for ICE) in the car's currency. Blank = assumption

label: Maintenance override
description: In the car's currency. Blank = assumption

label: Last updated
description: Date of the last check of this row
